YOUR PROGRESS . YOUR COPY

Back up or restore progress

Save a copy of your StudyLab work, then restore it in another browser or on another device. No account is needed.

This is manual backup, not automatic syncing. Download a fresh file after doing more work. Keep it private because it can contain your written answers and code. Live SQL database contents and unsaved edits are not copied. Exam timers do not pause during backup; a restored timed exam may already have expired.

1. Download your progress

Includes saved activities and drafts, completed lesson entries, checked quiz records, practice exam records and C#/Docker lesson notes. Only StudyLab learning data is included.

Review saved work

Transfer the downloaded .json file to the other device, for example through your own drive or a cable. Open this page there and choose the file below.

2. Choose a backup to preview

The file is read in this browser. Choosing it does not upload it to a server or change progress.

Backup preview

3. Protect your current work, then restore

Download a safety copy of this browser's current progress before applying changes. This safety copy includes display settings so you can recover them too.

StudyLab reloads after a successful restore to use the restored records. If you change saved work in another tab after this preview, preview the file again before restoring.
